1. **Top Welcome Banner Card**:
   - Clean, rounded-xl (12px), bordered card with subtle indigo-50/indigo-100 gradient accent or soft illustration badge.
   - Text: "Welcome back, Rahul! 👋" with subtext "You completed 4 lessons this week. You're on track to achieve your 'Data Analysis Specialist' certification."
   - Quick action: "View Study Plan" button or streak indicator (🔥 5-Day Learning Streak).

2. **KPI Stats Row (4 Cards across)**:
   - Modern cards, white bg, subtle border slate-200, rounded-xl, soft shadow-sm.
   - Stat 1: "Enrolled Courses" — Value: **5** (icon: BookOpen, secondary note: "2 in progress").
   - Stat 2: "Completed Lessons" — Value: **42** (icon: CheckCircle2, secondary note: "+6 this week", green badge).
   - Stat 3: "Hours Learned" — Value: **36.5** hrs (icon: Clock, secondary note: "Target: 40 hrs").
   - Stat 4: "Certificates" — Value: **1** (icon: Award, secondary note: "1 exam pending", amber badge).

3. **Main Two-Column Layout (approx 65% left, 35% right)**:
   - **Left Column: Continue Learning**:
     * Section header: "Continue Learning" with "View All (5)" link.
     * **Hero Resume Card**:
       - Highlighted course: **"Advanced Excel Masterclass"**
       - Badge: Level "Advanced" (red pill tag) and Category "Excel & Automation".
       - Circular SVG Progress Ring or prominent modern progress indicator displaying **68%**.
       - Details: Last watched lesson: **"Section 3: Power Query - Data Cleaning & ETL Pipelines"** (Lesson 18 of 26).
       - Time remaining: "22 mins remaining".
       - Primary CTA: Indigo-600 button with play icon: **"Resume Lesson"**.
     * **Compact Course Cards (2 rows below hero)**:
       - Row 1: **"SQL for Modern Data Analysis"** — Intermediate (amber tag). Thumbnail/icon preview, Progress bar at **45%** (18/40 lessons), Next lesson: "Module 4: Window Functions & Aggregations", "Resume" outlined button.
       - Row 2: **"Python for Business Dashboards"** — Beginner/Intermediate. Progress bar at **20%** (8/38 lessons), Next lesson: "Pandas DataFrames: Cleaning Messy CSVs", "Resume" outlined button.
     * **Skeleton Loading Demo Card**:
       - To showcase loading design requested by user: A card labeled with a small subtle tag "(Simulating Network Fetch)", displaying animated shimmering pulse skeleton loaders (`animate-pulse bg-slate-200`) for title, thumbnail, progress bar, and CTA button.

   - **Right Column: Insights, Activity & Deadlines**:
     * **"Overall Progress" Card**:
       - Title "Weekly Learning Activity" with total: "7.5 hrs this week (+18% vs last week)".
       - Visual Bar Chart representation (Mon to Sun) showing hours per day with indigo-600 bars and slate-100 inactive bars, tooltip on highest day (Thu: 2.2 hrs).
     * **"Recent Announcements" Card**:
       - 3 announcement items with unread indicator dot, date, and category tag:
         1. "Live Q&A Session: Advanced DAX & Power BI on Friday 6 PM" (Tag: Live Cohort, Date: Today, unread blue dot).
         2. "New Exercise Dataset: Q3 Financial Ledger available for download" (Tag: Excel Masterclass, Date: Yesterday).
         3. "PostgreSQL 16 Playground Environment Updated" (Tag: SQL Platform, Date: Oct 12).
     * **"Upcoming Deadlines" Card**:
       - "Capstone Project: Financial Modeling Valuation Model" — Due in 2 days (Oct 18, 11:59 PM). Status: Draft saved. "Submit Project" secondary button.

Design Rules & Aesthetic:
- Clean SaaS aesthetic, Inter font, 8px spacing, rounded-xl (12px) cards, crisp 1px borders (#E2E8F0), subtle hover states.
- Color balance: crisp white, slate-50 background, slate-900 typography, indigo-600 primary accents, amber-400 ratings/pills, emerald-500 positive metrics.
- Keep layout perfectly balanced, well-spaced, and ultra-high
